instruction: The default VLC volume maximum of 125% is usually enough, but sometimes I need just a bit more. Can you increase the max volume to 150%?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's max volume to 150% (qt-max-volume=150 in vlcrc config file). Nearly identical to original task but with different target value (150% vs 200%).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly maps to instruction requirement: checks qt-max-volume setting in vlcrc config file
Getter logic is correct: locates and reads vlcrc config file for the appropriate OS (Linux/Darwin/Windows)
Metric logic is correct: parses config file, extracts qt-max-volume value, compares with expected '150'
Expected value is semantically correct: 150 matches the instruction's requirement to set max volume to 150%
Postconfig is appropriate: kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are written to disk
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (set max volume to 150%), evaluator checks exactly this
Edge cases handled: default value (125), type conversion (int to string), file errors
